description: Generates a TON deployment deeplink for a compiled Tolk contract. Accepts the compiled code BoC (base64) and optionally initial data BoC. Computes the contract address and returns ton:// deeplinks for wallet deployment.

amount.description: Amount in nanoTON to send with deploy message (default: "50000000" = 0.05 TON)

codeBoc64.description: Base64-encoded BoC of the compiled contract code (from compile_tolk output)

initialDataBoc64.description: Base64-encoded BoC for the contract initial data cell (default: empty cell)

name: generate_deploy_link
